title: pvTensorPrincipalInvariants
body:
## pvTensorPrincipalInvariants

Computes the principal values and principal directions of selected symmetric tensor arrays (for example stress or strain). For each selected array <name> it adds <name> - Sigma 1, 2 and 3 (values sorted from largest to smallest) and the matching <name> - Sigma n (Vector) direction arrays, keeping the input arrays. Accepted tensors have 6 components in the order XX, YY, ZZ, XY, YZ, XZ, or 3 components named XX, YY, XY for 2-D tensors. Use pvYieldCriteria when you need Tresca or von Mises values.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Full 9-component tensors are not accepted; extract the symmetric 6-component form first.
- A 3-component array is treated as a 2-D tensor only when its component names are exactly XX, YY and XY; otherwise it is ignored as a vector.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `TensorPrincipalInvariants`. Identity: `filters/TensorPrincipalInvariants`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

ParaView: This property specifies the input. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

| `PointTensors` | Point tensors from which to compute principal invariants. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ScalePrincipalVectorsWithPrincipalValues` | Principal vectors can be scaled by the principal values instead of being unitary. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
